exam: IBPS CRP PO/MT-XVI, notification dated 30 June 2026
note: 200 × 230 pixels are preferred dimensions. Use a recent colour photo with a light background, preferably white. The application also requires a separate live capture. This formatter does not replace it.

name: IBPS PO/MT-XVI · signature
exam: IBPS CRP PO/MT-XVI, notification dated 30 June 2026
note: 140 × 60 pixels are preferred dimensions. Sign on white paper using black ink, not in capital letters. Check that every original stroke remains visible after resizing or cleanup.
